verdict.rationale: Shortwave offers triggers that automatically draft replies, organize threads into todos, add comments, and connect to 3,000+ apps when emails arrive—this is genuine autonomous background automation tied to email events, plus custom AI filters that run scripts automatically. However, this is scoped narrowly to email-triggered actions rather than general-purpose scheduled/autonomous agent workflows, and there's no independent verification of reliability or scope. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of triggers running reliably in production, broader autonomous scheduling beyond email-triggered events, and details on error handling/oversight for background automations.
